eyebrow.zh: 通过统一 CLI 调用飞书、钉钉、企业微信和腾讯文档的已实现资源接口，分别管理各套件授权。
eyebrow.en: Use a shared CLI for implemented Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom and Tencent Docs resource APIs while managing authorization separately for each suite.

headline.zh: 用同一套命令组织办公套件操作。
headline.en: Use one CLI for office-suite operations.

sub.zh: 通过统一 CLI 调用飞书、钉钉、企业微信和腾讯文档的已实现资源接口，分别管理各套件授权。
sub.en: Use a shared CLI for implemented Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom and Tencent Docs resource APIs while managing authorization separately for each suite.

caption.zh: 图示展示组件关系；实际输出见下方示例。
caption.en: An illustrative component scene; recorded output appears below.

body.zh: 资源操作经过公共分发器。
body.en: Resource operations use a shared dispatcher.
Tokens are separately cached and checked.

body.zh: 支持资源 JSON 输入输出。
body.en: Resource operations support JSON input and output.

body.zh: 多个办公套件有不同资源类型和登录方式。suiter 用 Suite 接口与公共命令分发器统一调用形状，把各套件令牌放进同一个本地存储。统一命令不意味着一次登录能授权所有套件；应用配置、权限和登录仍按套件完成。
body.en: Office suites have different resources and login flows. suiter uses a Suite interface and shared dispatcher to standardize command shape, with per-suite tokens in one local store. A shared CLI does not authorize every suite with one login: application configuration, permissions and login remain suite-specific.

body.zh: 对四个已注册客户端分别请求 doc/calendar/message/sheet，验证过期令牌均返回明确的重新登录提示。它是离线鉴权前置检查，不是实际账户读写成功记录。
body.en: Request doc/calendar/message/sheet through four clients and verify each returns a clear re-login error for an expired token. This is offline authentication preflight, not evidence of successful account reads or writes.

alt.zh: 对四个已注册客户端分别请求 doc/calendar/message/sheet，验证过期令牌均返回明确的重新登录提示。它是离线鉴权前置检查，不是实际账户读写成功记录。
alt.en: Request doc/calendar/message/sheet through four clients and verify each returns a clear re-login error for an expired token. This is offline authentication preflight, not evidence of successful account reads or writes.

body.zh: Cobra CLI 构建四个客户端的注册表，读操作返回 JSON，写操作从 stdin 接收 JSON。TokenStore 保存并检查各套件令牌；客户端负责 HTTP 与 API 错误。agent 子命令另有读取飞书、调用摘要模型、创建钉钉日历事件的组合路径。
body.en: The Cobra CLI builds a registry of four clients. Reads return JSON and writes consume JSON from stdin. TokenStore persists per-suite tokens; clients validate tokens and handle HTTP/API errors. The agent command separately combines a Feishu read, model summary and DingTalk event creation.

alt.en: The Cobra CLI builds a registry of four clients. Reads return JSON and writes consume JSON from stdin. TokenStore persists per-suite tokens; clients validate tokens and handle HTTP/API errors. The agent command separately combines a Feishu read, model summary and DingTalk event creation.

body.zh: 飞书当前核心读 doc；钉钉为 calendar，企微为 message，腾讯文档为 sheet。客户端接口是否已实现，与某个账户是否具备相应资源权限是两项条件。演示只验证令牌过期时的本地前置检查。
body.en: Feishu’s current core reads docs; DingTalk covers calendars, WeCom messages and Tencent Docs sheets. An implemented client and an account with the necessary permissions are separate requirements. The demo only checks local handling of expired tokens.

body.en: Feishu’s current core reads docs; DingTalk covers calendars, WeCom messages and Tencent Docs sheets. An implemented client and an account with the necessary permissions are separate requirements. The demo only checks local handling of expired tokens.

body.zh: 配置文件由 `--config` 选择，默认 `~/.suiter/config.yaml`；SUITER_ 环境变量可覆盖配置值。四组凭证前缀为 FEISHU_APP、DINGTALK_APP、WEWORK 与 TENCENTDOCS_CLIENT，模型使用 SUITER_LLM_BASE_URL/API_KEY/MODEL。令牌在 `~/.suiter/tokens.json`，权限 0600。logout 清理本地缓存，不等同服务端撤销授权；过期令牌需要重新登录。
body.en: `--config` selects a file, defaulting to `~/.suiter/config.yaml`; SUITER_ environment variables override configuration values. Credential prefixes are FEISHU_APP, DINGTALK_APP, WEWORK and TENCENTDOCS_CLIENT; model configuration uses SUITER_LLM_BASE_URL/API_KEY/MODEL. Tokens live in `~/.suiter/tokens.json` with mode 0600. logout clears local cache, not server-side authorization; expired tokens require login again.

note.zh: 对四个已注册客户端分别请求 doc/calendar/message/sheet，验证过期令牌均返回明确的重新登录提示。它是离线鉴权前置检查，不是实际账户读写成功记录。
note.en: Request doc/calendar/message/sheet through four clients and verify each returns a clear re-login error for an expired token. This is offline authentication preflight, not evidence of successful account reads or writes.

body.zh: 四个客户端在资源访问前拒绝过期令牌。
body.en: All four clients reject the expired token before resource access.

body.zh: 需要 Go 1.24+。以下 go run 使用生产客户端和合成过期令牌，不读取用户令牌文件、不启动登录或发送服务请求。
body.en: Requires Go 1.24+. The go run example uses production clients with a synthetic expired token. It reads no user token file, starts no login and sends no service request.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/suiter.git
cd suiter
go build -o bin/suiter ./cmd/suiter

limitations.zh: 本次未登录真实套件，未验证平台接口、权限或跨套件写入；原有 GIF 为无凭证语法巡览。
limitations.en: No real suite login, platform API, permission or cross-suite write was validated. The existing GIF is a credential-free syntax tour.

limitations.zh: 统一 CLI 不提供组织级授权，也不保证四个服务所有功能或所有账户可用。
limitations.en: A shared CLI does not provide organization-wide authorization or guarantee every feature and account works across all four services.

changelog.en: WeCom corpsecret no longer leaks via URL errors; suite HTTP calls now time out instead of hanging; config writes are concurrency-safe; dingtalk/tencentdocs writes no longer fake success on error envelopes.
changelog.zh: 企微 corpsecret 不再通过 URL 错误泄露；套件 HTTP 调用现在会超时而非挂起；配置写入并发安全；钉钉/腾讯文档写入不再在错误信封上伪造成功。

changelog.note: refresh: content re-verified for v0.7.0 (fix-dingtalk-tencentdocs-read-error-envelope — read paths now surface error envelopes instead of returning them as content).

changelog.en: suiter --version now reports the release: cobra's --version was never wired, so the binary could not self-report its version. A lockstep regression test now guards the VERSION file, the --version output, the site content_version, and the CHANGELOG head entry so a bump can no longer leave a surface a release behind.
changelog.zh: suiter --version 现在能正确报出版本号：此前 cobra 的 --version 从未接线，二进制无法自报版本。新增一致性回归测试守卫 VERSION 文件、--version 输出、站点 content_version 与 CHANGELOG 头条，升级时不再漏改某个版本面。
